title: Graph attachment fetch cannot retrieve paged attachments by ID
reasoning: fetch_message explicitly pages through the attachments endpoint and records attachment IDs, but fetch_attachment first lists /attachments without $top or @odata.nextLink handling and only searches that first response before fetching details. An attachment ID discovered from a later page by fetch_message may be reported in metadata but then be unretrievable through fetch_attachment.
recommendation: Either fetch the requested attachment directly when attachment_index is an ID, or page through /attachments consistently when resolving an index or ID.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked Graph attachment tests are included, especially not a paginated attachment response.
suggestedRegressionTest: Mock Graph attachments with an @odata.nextLink where the requested attachment ID appears on the second page, then assert fetch_attachment returns it.
minimumFixScope: Update GraphReadOnlyConnector.fetch_attachment attachment lookup to handle IDs directly or follow pagination.
